justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ByteArrayClassLoader.java` (lines 1420-1495). `PrependingEnumeration` is a small nested helper that depends only on `URL`, `Enumeration<URL>`, `MaybeNull`, and `NoSuchElementException`, and repo-wide search found only one use site: the single `new PrependingEnumeration(url, super.getResources(name))` call in `ByteArrayClassLoader.getResources`. No other classes reference this nested class, so it does not show the high fan-in and fan-out expected for hub-like modularization.
